protocol.status: posthoc robustness and endpoint diagnostics; primary target-first results are retained
protocol.clusters: identical rendered prompt strings, separately within each condition
protocol.intervals: paired prompt-cluster bootstrap, preserving the original item-weighted point estimate by resampling cluster sums and counts
protocol.equal_unique_prompt_delta: additional point estimate giving every distinct rendered prompt equal weight
protocol.heldout_scope: original item keys include the receiver; distinct item keys do not guarantee distinct facts or neutral QA prompts
protocol.secondary_endpoint: target_without_alternative is literal target mention with no listed alternative anywhere; it does not resolve negation, quotations, or separate statements about another speaker
protocol.selection: all named edits and both measured controls; no selection by effect direction
